name: CorsixTH
tagline: Open source clone of Theme Hospital
blurb: CorsixTH aims to reimplement the game engine of Theme Hospital, and be able to load the original game data files.
description:
CorsixTH aims to reimplement the game engine of Theme Hospital, and be
able to load the original game data files. This means that you will need
a purchased copy of Theme Hospital, or a copy of the demo, in order to
use CorsixTH. After most of the original engine has been reimplemented in
open source code, the project will serve as a base from which extensions
and improvements to the original game can be made.

install.label: Flatpak
install.note: Works on every distribution, sandboxed and kept up to date for you.
